feature: Extend Quality Metrics with Code Coverage Tracking
workflow_rationale: Straightforward extension of existing quality tracking infrastructure. Adding coverage fields to existing data models and integrating with CoverageAnalyzer.

phases.name: Backend Quality Models Extension
phases.description: Extend QualityScore to include coverage data and integrate CoverageAnalyzer

subtasks.description: Add coverage fields to QualityScore dataclass

verification.command: python -c "from analysis.quality_models import QualityScore; import inspect; fields = [f.name for f in QualityScore.__dataclass_fields__.values()]; assert 'coverage_percent' in fields and 'lines_covered' in fields and 'lines_total' in fields, 'Missing coverage fields'; print('OK')"

subtasks.notes: Add coverage_percent (float 0-100), lines_covered (int), lines_total (int) fields. Update to_dict/from_dict methods.

subtasks.description: Update QualityTracker to integrate coverage data

verification.command: python -c "from analysis.quality_tracker import calculate_quality_score; from pathlib import Path; score = calculate_quality_score(Path('.auto-claude/specs/test'), 'test-session', 'coder'); assert hasattr(score, 'coverage_percent'), 'Missing coverage_percent'; print('OK')"

subtasks.notes: Add optional coverage_result parameter to calculate_quality_score. If provided, populate coverage fields from CoverageResult.

subtasks.description: Update get_quality_metrics MCP tool to include coverage

verification.command: python -c "from agents.tools_pkg.tools.statistics import create_statistics_tools; from pathlib import Path; tools = create_statistics_tools(Path('.'), Path('.auto-claude/specs/test')); tool = [t for t in tools if t.name == 'get_quality_metrics'][0]; print('OK')"

subtasks.notes: Add coverage section to quality metrics output. Read coverage from quality_history.json if available.

phases.name: Frontend Quality Store Update
phases.description: Update TypeScript interfaces to include coverage fields

subtasks.description: Add coverage fields to QualityScore interface
subtasks.notes: Add coverage_percent?: number, lines_covered?: number, lines_total?: number to QualityScore interface. Fields are optional to support legacy data.

verification_steps.name: Import Check
verification_steps.command: python -c "from analysis.quality_models import QualityScore; from analysis.quality_tracker import calculate_quality_score; print('OK')"

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk change - extending existing data structures without breaking changes. Coverage fields are optional to maintain backward compatibility.
